questions.title: Sliding Window Maximum
questions.statement:
You are given an integer array \`nums\` and a sliding window of size \`k\` that moves from the left of the array to the right. At each position, consider only the \`k\` values inside the window.

Return the maximum value in every sliding window.

### Example 1

**Input:** \`nums = [1, 3, -1, -3, 5, 3, 6, 7]\
questions.inputFormat: The first line contains the space-separated elements of nums. The second line contains k.
questions.outputFormat: Print the maximum of each window as space-separated integers.
